correctness.rationale: Direct degree inequalities give all faces and facets. Collapsing contractible shore simplices (CW cofibrations) identifies the quotient with an unreduced suspension of an explicit square complex Q. The central component of Q collapses onto K_t by filling independently the parallel path squares; other vertices are exactly (a-t)(b-t) isolates. Thus the claimed integral homotopy and Betti ranks follow for every parameter. 28 independent exhaustive finite checks passed but do not certify generality.

value.rationale: A natural matching-deletion interpolation of complete bipartite graphs yields, for 3<=t<min(a,b), torsion-free mixed-dimensional homotopy with explicit independent first- and second-homology ranks, rather than only an extremal vertex-set statistic. The same complete structural theorem gives all-set and maximal-face enumerators and locates the transition between known S1 and S2 endpoints.
